note: Control titles and objectives from ISO/IEC 42001:2023. Requirement text uses ISO clause/control objective language; replace with licensed verbatim text from sources/iso-42001/ when available.

requirements.title: Understanding the organization and its context
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and that affect its ability to achieve the intended outcome(s) of its AI management system.

requirements.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall determine the interested parties that are relevant to the AI management system and the requirements of these interested parties relevant to the AI management system.

requirements.title: Leadership and commitment
requirements.requirementText: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment with respect to the AI management system.

requirements.title: AI policy
requirements.requirementText: Top management shall establish an AI policy that is appropriate to the purpose of the organization, includes a framework for setting AI objectives, includes a commitment to meet applicable requirements, and includes a commitment to continual improvement of the AI management system.

requirements.title: AI risk assessment
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall define and apply an AI risk assessment process to identify risks associated with the development, provision or use of AI systems.

requirements.title: AI risk treatment
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall define and apply an AI risk treatment process to select and implement options for addressing AI risks.

requirements.title: Determining the scope of the AI management system
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the AI management system to establish its scope. When determining this scope, the organization shall consider the external and internal issues referred to in 4.1, the requirements referred to in 4.2, and the AI systems and related activities within the organization.

requirements.title: AI management system
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall establish, implement, maintain and continually improve an AI management system, including the processes needed and their interactions, in accordance with the requirements of this document.

requirements.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
requirements.requirementText: Top management shall ensure that the responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles are assigned and communicated within the organization. Top management shall assign the responsibility and authority for ensuring that the AI management system conforms to the requirements of this document and reporting on the performance of the AI management system to top management.

requirements.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
requirements.requirementText: When planning for the AI management system, the organization shall consider the issues referred to in 4.1 and the requirements referred to in 4.2, and determine the risks and opportunities that need to be addressed to give assurance that the AI management system can achieve its intended outcome(s), prevent or reduce undesired effects, and achieve continual improvement.

requirements.title: AI system impact assessment
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall establish a process for assessing the potential consequences for individuals or groups of individuals, and societies, that can result from the development, provision or use of AI systems.

requirements.title: Resources
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall determine and provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance and continual improvement of the AI management system.

requirements.title: Competence
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall determine the necessary competence of person(s) doing work under its control that affects its AI performance; ensure that these persons are competent on the basis of appropriate education, training, or experience; and retain appropriate documented information as evidence of competence.

requirements.title: Awareness
requirements.requirementText: Persons doing work under the organization's control shall be aware of the AI policy, their contribution to the effectiveness of the AI management system, and the implications of not conforming with the AI management system requirements.

requirements.title: Communication
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall determine the internal and external communications relevant to the AI management system, including what, when, with whom, and how to communicate.

requirements.title: Documented information
requirements.requirementText: The organization's AI management system shall include documented information required by this document and determined by the organization as being necessary for the effectiveness of the AI management system.

requirements.title: Operational planning and control
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall plan, implement and control the processes needed to meet AI management system requirements, and to implement the actions determined in Clause 6, by establishing criteria for the processes and implementing control of the processes in accordance with the criteria.

requirements.title: AI system life cycle
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall establish, implement and maintain processes for the responsible design, development, production, testing, deployment, operation, monitoring, maintenance and decommissioning of AI systems throughout their life cycles.

requirements.title: Data for AI systems
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall establish, implement and maintain processes for the management of data used in the development and operation of AI systems, including data quality, provenance, preparation and governance.

requirements.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall determine what needs to be monitored and measured, the methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation needed to ensure valid results, and when the monitoring and measuring shall be performed and the results analysed and evaluated.

requirements.title: Internal audit
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to provide information on whether the AI management system conforms to the organization's own requirements and the requirements of this document, and is effectively implemented and maintained.

requirements.title: Management review
requirements.requirementText: Top management shall review the organization's AI management system at planned intervals to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.

requirements.title: Continual improvement
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the AI management system.

requirements.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
requirements.requirementText: When a nonconformity occurs, the organization shall react to the nonconformity, evaluate the need for action to eliminate its causes, implement any action needed, review the effectiveness of any corrective action taken, and update the AI management system if necessary.

requirements.title: Objectives for responsible development of AI system
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall identify and document objectives to guide the responsible development of AI systems, and take those objectives into account and integrate measures to achieve them in the development life cycle.

requirements.title: Processes for responsible AI system design and development
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall define and document the specific processes for the responsible design and development of the AI system.

requirements.title: AI policy
requirements.requirementText: An AI policy shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated and acknowledged within the organization and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals.

requirements.title: Alignment with other organizational policies
requirements.requirementText: The AI policy shall be aligned with other organizational policies, including those relating to information security, privacy, quality and safety.

requirements.title: Review of the AI policy
requirements.requirementText: The AI policy shall be reviewed at planned intervals or when significant changes occur to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.

requirements.title: AI roles and responsibilities
requirements.requirementText: Roles and responsibilities for the AI management system shall be defined and allocated according to the needs of the organization.

requirements.title: Reporting of concerns
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall establish a process for reporting concerns about the organization's role with respect to an AI system throughout its life cycle.

requirements.title: Resource documentation
requirements.requirementText: Resources relevant to the AI management system shall be documented.

requirements.title: Data resources
requirements.requirementText: Data resources shall be managed throughout the AI system life cycle.

requirements.title: Tooling resources
requirements.requirementText: Tooling resources, including hardware and software, shall be managed throughout the AI system life cycle.

requirements.title: System and computing resources
requirements.requirementText: System and computing resources shall be managed throughout the AI system life cycle.

requirements.title: Human resources
requirements.requirementText: Human resources shall be managed throughout the AI system life cycle.

requirements.title: AI system impact assessment process
requirements.requirementText: An AI system impact assessment process shall be defined and implemented.

requirements.title: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
requirements.requirementText: AI system impact assessments shall be documented.

requirements.title: Assessing AI system impact on individuals or groups of individuals
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall assess and document the potential impacts of AI systems on individuals or groups of individuals.

requirements.title: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
requirements.requirementText: The organization shall assess and document the potential societal impacts of AI systems.

requirements.title: AI system requirements and specification
requirements.requirementText: Requirements and specifications for the development of AI systems shall be defined and documented.

requirements.title: Documentation of AI system design and development
requirements.requirementText: AI system design and development shall be documented.

requirements.title: AI system verification and validation
requirements.requirementText: AI systems shall be verified and validated against defined requirements.

requirements.title: AI system deployment
requirements.requirementText: AI system deployment shall be planned, documented and controlled.

requirements.title: AI system operation and monitoring
requirements.requirementText: AI systems shall be operated and monitored according to documented procedures.

requirements.title: AI system technical documentation
requirements.requirementText: Technical documentation for AI systems shall be maintained.

requirements.title: AI system recording of event logs
requirements.requirementText: Event logs for AI systems shall be recorded and maintained.

requirements.title: Data for development and enhancement of AI system
requirements.requirementText: Data for the development and enhancement of AI systems shall be managed.

requirements.title: Acquisition of data
requirements.requirementText: Data acquisition shall be managed throughout the AI system life cycle.

requirements.title: Quality of data for AI systems
requirements.requirementText: The quality of data for AI systems shall be managed.

requirements.title: Data provenance
requirements.requirementText: Data provenance shall be documented and maintained.

requirements.title: Data preparation
requirements.requirementText: Data preparation shall be managed.

requirements.title: System documentation and information for users
requirements.requirementText: System documentation and information for users shall be provided.

requirements.title: External reporting
requirements.requirementText: External reporting mechanisms shall be established.

requirements.title: Communication of incidents
requirements.requirementText: Incidents shall be communicated to interested parties as appropriate.

requirements.title: Information for interested parties
requirements.requirementText: Information for interested parties shall be provided as appropriate.

requirements.title: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
requirements.requirementText: Processes for responsible use of AI systems shall be defined and implemented.

requirements.title: Objectives for responsible use of AI systems
requirements.requirementText: Objectives for responsible use of AI systems shall be defined.

requirements.title: Intended use of AI systems
requirements.requirementText: The intended use of AI systems shall be documented.

requirements.title: Allocating responsibilities
requirements.requirementText: Responsibilities shall be allocated between the organization, its partners, suppliers and customers.

requirements.title: Suppliers
requirements.requirementText: Suppliers shall be managed throughout the AI system life cycle.

requirements.title: Customers
requirements.requirementText: Customers shall be managed throughout the AI system life cycle.
